title: Lens Distortion
summary: Lens Distortion image filter separates an image into shifting color layers (recreating the chromatic aberration of a lens) and warps the image geometry, curving it outward or inward like barrel and pi

params.name: fit
params.description: How to fit the rendered shader into the canvas dimensions (0 = none, 1 = contain, 2 = cover)

params.name: spread
params.description: Strength of the color split; how far the color layers are pushed apart; 0 is off

params.name: bias
params.description: Shifts the colors toward one end of the spread; 0 spaces them evenly, needs spread > 0, count > 2

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction of the spread in degrees, needs spread > 0, perspective < 1

params.name: perspective
params.description: Shapes the spread direction from a straight line (0) to a radial burst out from the centre (1), needs spread > 0

params.name: count
params.description: Number of sampled color layers along the spread; higher is smoother and costlier, needs spread > 0

params.name: dispersion
params.description: Overall amount of color dispersion; 1 gives each layer its own color from the spectrum, 0 keeps the original image color, needs spread > 0

params.name: dispersionColor
params.description: Rotates the colors around the hue wheel, 0 to 1 for a full turn, needs spread > 0, dispersion > 0

params.name: focusCenter
params.description: Reduces the spread in a circular zone at the centre; 0 keeps it full to the centre, needs spread > 0

params.name: focusEdges
params.description: Reduces the spread toward the edges; 0 keeps it full to the edges, 1 restores the original image there, needs spread > 0

notes: Uses an image (installed to brand/assets/materials/); swap `image` for your own picture or texture.
Breathes on `swirl` from 0.1 to 0.6 so a still shader stays alive.
